summary:
Turn 33 read the previously deferred client surface and answered the client half of the new candidate's question with sources.

What was read and established. SendProposal writes each proposal exactly once — to the leader, or to the closest replica in the leaderless EPaxos configuration that run.go sets up — and never re-sends it (client/client.go SendProposal). The reply path is a blocking read: BufferClient.WaitReplies loops on GetReplyFrom(waitFrom) and leaves the loop only when the read errors (for example net.ErrClosed), at which point it logs and stops rather than re-issuing the request (client/buffer.go WaitReplies, client/client.go GetReplyFrom). There is no reply deadline, no outstanding-request table and no CommandId-based retransmission.

Consequence for the question. Put together with the replica side already read, a proposal whose instance is committed as NOOP by a recovery is never completed anywhere: the recovering replica never held those proposals (it preserves only its own record's clientProposals), the re-propose branch requires the commit to land on the committing replica's own row and carry a single NONE command (handleCommit), and the client does not re-issue the request. The candidate's main unknown — whether the client library retries — is therefore answered negatively, and the sources for that answer are now registered as materials (the three client ranges) rather than remaining a deferred surface.

What remains, recorded rather than assumed. Whether the replica implementation is expected to complete another replica's proposal when it recovers that replica's instance (no read path adopts the owner's proposals), whether the captured client library is part of the audited contract or only a load driver (it is a test driver with no retry), and whether the missing completion can be observed with the harness machinery already built (a proposal attached to a NOOP-committed instance plus a reply stream that never receives anything). Both unknowns are refined on the candidate, its resume conditions stay empty while it remains active, and no map object was changed. The three confirmed claims and the paused accept-status candidate are untouched; no requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
